activity.notes: Finnish reference works identify Häyhä as a sniper of Infantry Regiment 34 at Kollaa during the Winter War; Yle notes that his front-line service lasted only about three months before he was wounded. ATLAS therefore uses only the approximate 1939-1940 Winter War service envelope and does not encode disputed kill totals.
